Walk-in Interview – Visiting Faculty (Fall 2026)

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, a public sector university, requires
the services of
visiting faculty
for semester

Fall-2026
in the following disciplines. Interested/
eligible candidates may appear through walk-in interview as per the
following schedule.

📋 Interview Schedule

S. No. | Discipline | No. of Visiting Faculty Required | Minimum Required Qualification | Venue & Time
1 | Computer Science | 02 Positions | MPhil/MS in the relevant field from an HEC recognized
University/Institution | Office of the Dean, Faculty of Physical & Numerical Sciences,
Garden Campus AWKUM Monday, September 28, 2026 10:00 am
2 | University College for Women (UCW) | 01 Position Female only

Date

Monday, September 28, 2026

Time

10:00 am

Venue

Office of the Dean, Faculty of Physical & Numerical Sciences,
Garden Campus AWKUM

✎ Terms & Conditions

Applicants are required to fill the

Application Form (https://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/Forms/Job_Forms/Application_form_AWKUM-New.docx)
available on

AWKUM website (https://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/Forms/Job_Forms/Application_form_AWKUM-New.docx)

along with their CVs on the interview day.

Candidates shall bring original documents along with attested
photocopies of all DMCs, Degrees, Certificates, Experience Certificate,
CNIC and one recent passport size photograph.

The engagement shall be on visiting basis for one semester,
i.e.
Fall-2026
.

The applicants are required to reach the mentioned venue on the given
date and time.

The engagement shall be governed by the terms & conditions to be
mentioned in the letter of engagement.

The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number
of seats or not to fill the posts as per need.

No TA/DA shall be admissible for the interview.

Important:

Applicants must fill and bring the Application Form on the interview
day, along with their CV and all required original/attested documents.

⬇ Download Application Form (https://awkum.edu.pk/Downloads/Forms/Job_Forms/Application_form_AWKUM-New.docx)

🌐 Visit AWKUM Website (https://www.awkum.edu.pk)

Note: Errors and Omissions are liable to subsequent rectification by
the university authorities.
